Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding an integrated high quality continuum of early learning.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an integrated high quality continuum of earlylearning; and adding a new section to chapter 43.215 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.215 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: At such time as the amount of funds distributed annually to thegeneral fund pursuant to RCW 69.50.540 is determined, the legislatureshall prioritize funding for an integrated high quality continuum ofearly learning, called early start, for children birthtofive years ofage. Components of early start include, but are not limited to, thefollowing: (1) Home visiting and parent education and support programs; (2) The early achievers program described in RCW 43.215.100; (3) Integrated fullday, high quality early learning programs; and (4) High quality preschool for children whose family income is ator below one hundred ten percent of the federal poverty level.
